opening: I've got a tiny site in the site folder here, just two pages. Can you put it online so anyone can read it, no sign-in needed? Tell me the address.
goal: the two pages online on the static host, readable without signing in, with the address
checklist: both pages answer 200 without a login
it does not build a live app for plain files
facts: Plain files belong on the static host (site.localhost:<port> on this server); the live host is for apps.
